features.quote: If the agent outputs the exact same token sequence for 3 consecutive turns, terminate the run. This prevents uncontrolled looping.
If the output contains phrases like "I am unable to proceed," "This task is impossible," or "I am stuck," log this as a "Self-Termination" event and allow the model 1 final turn to explain why.
A secondary LLM (e.g., GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet) is prompted to act as a Welfare Evaluator. It reads the full transcript of a run and outputs a JSON object.
